entities.name: Darja Semeņistaja
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Darja Semeņistaja is a Latvian tennis player. She has career-high WTA rankings of world No. 87 in singles, achieved on 27 October 2025, and No. 119 in doubles, reached on 8 September 2025. She has won two singles and two doubles titles on the WTA Challenger Tour.
